title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: Hold: the briefing overlooks published licensing rights for bulk PST import and rates the cost as indirect only despite the required Azure storage being metered. The roadmap dates, Message Center workflow and Azure role-assignment controls are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans direct import of PST files in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The method follows a two-step Exchange Migration Service analysis-then-migration pattern.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.claim: Administrators create a migration endpoint before running the migration batches.
claims.quote: The process also involves creating a migration endpoint, running an analysis-only migration batch

claims.claim: Administrators first run an analysis-only migration batch.
claims.quote: running an analysis-only migration batch

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Administrators use the analysis results to configure and start the final import batch.
claims.quote: using the analysis results to configure the final batch, and then starting the batch to import PST content into target mailboxes.

claims.claim: The Azure PST Import workflow uses PowerShell cmdlets only.
claims.quote: Administrators complete the Azure PST Import process using PowerShell cmdlets only.

claims.claim: Azure PST Import has no graphical user interface.
claims.quote: This experience is not available through a graphical user interface (GUI).

claims.claim: The process provides analysis results and reports for administrators to review.
claims.quote: by validating readiness before importing and by providing reports throughout the process.

claims.claim: The existing Microsoft Purview portal PST import service offers network upload and drive shipping.
claims.quote:
Network upload: Upload the PST files over the network to a temporary Azure Storage location in the Microsoft cloud.
Drive shipping: Copy the PST files to a BitLocker-encrypted hard drive and then physically ship the drive to Microsoft.

claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import jobs are created on the Import PST files page in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Create a PST import job on the Import PST files page in the Microsoft Purview portal and submit the PST import mapping file you created in the previous step.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Licensing is wholly unpublished and the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote:
To bulk-import PST files to Exchange Online mailboxes, the following licenses provide user rights:
- Exchange Online P2
- Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included for the published bulk-PST-import user rights. Replace the blanket licensing gap throughout with: 'Microsoft publishes bulk-PST-import user rights for Exchange Online P2, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW, Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection and Governance, and Office 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3. Additional Azure PST Import-specific licensing or charges are not yet published.' Cite this service-description URL; keep the additional-feature-charge question narrow.

claims.claim: Exchange or Purview administrator roles required for the new Azure PST Import cmdlets are not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Exchange PowerShell Azure PST Import roles permissions endpoint Analyze authentication; "Azure PST Import" PowerShell cmdlets roles license pricing authentication Analyze XML CSV. Opened pst-import-overview and New-MigrationEndpoint; only legacy roles found.

claims.claim: Neither a graphical control nor a documented runnable command for the new endpoint, Analyze batch and import batch was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Azure PST Import"; "PSTImport" "Migration"; "Azure PST Import" PowerShell Analyze batch XML CSV documentation. Opened New-MigrationEndpoint and pst-import-overview; no command documented for this workflow. MC1455013 explicitly excludes GUI.

claims.claim: Azure role assignment is reached through Access control (IAM) > Role assignments > Add > Add role assignment.
claims.quote:
Click Access control (IAM).
Click the Role assignments tab to view the role assignments at this scope.
Click Add > Add role assignment.
claims.fix: Include the omitted resource-selection step: 'storage account > Access control (IAM) > Role assignments > Add > Add role assignment'. Use the same path in the rendered table.

claims.claim: The printed az role assignment create call can assign Storage Blob Data Reader by object ID and principal type at storage-account scope.
claims.quote:
az role assignment create \
    --role "Storage Blob Data Reader" \
    --assignee-object-id "aaaaaaaa-0000-1111-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb" \
    --assignee-principal-type "User"

claims.claim: Assigning the storage role requires role-assignment permission at the storage account or a higher scope.
claims.quote: To run the command, you must have a role that includes Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write permissions assigned to you at the corresponding scope or higher.

claims.claim: Administrator access to PowerShell cmdlets and Azure role assignments govern the feature.
claims.quote: The feature is controlled through administrator access to PowerShell cmdlets and Azure role assignments, including permissions on the Azure storage account used for PST import.

claims.claim: For the existing Purview import service, Learn lists Mailbox Import Export and Mail Recipients, or Global Administrator, for creating import jobs.
claims.quote:
To create import jobs and import PST files, you need the following roles:
- Mailbox Import Export role in Exchange Online.
- Mail Recipients role in Exchange Online.
Or
- You're a global administrator in your organization.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the legacy import-job role requirements govern the new Azure PST Import cmdlets.
claims.quote: Searched: Exchange PowerShell Azure PST Import roles permissions endpoint Analyze authentication; "Azure PST Import" audit events cloud roles GUI. Opened pst-import-overview and New-MigrationEndpoint and read MC1455013; no statement connecting legacy roles to the new cmdlets.

claims.claim: New-MigrationEndpoint lists a PSTImport parameter set without explaining this feature's workflow.
claims.quote:
### -PSTImport
This parameter is available only in on-premises Exchange.
This parameter is reserved for internal Microsoft use.
claims.fix: Replace the clause about the reference with: 'The New-MigrationEndpoint reference lists PSTImport but marks the parameter as on-premises-only and reserved for internal Microsoft use; it does not document the Azure PST Import workflow.'

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A low, indirect-cost-only rating fits a workflow requiring an Azure storage account holding the PST files.
claims.quote: Page: 'cost: low'; 'an Azure storage account to hold the PST files'. Learn: 'When you create or use Blob Storage resources, you're charged for the following meters:'; 'Data storage | Per GB / per month'; 'Operations | Per transaction'.
claims.fix: Set cost to variable. Replace the cost rationale with: 'Variable. The required Azure Blob Storage is metered for data storage per GB per month and operations per transaction; admin time also applies. Additional Azure PST Import-specific charges are not yet published.' Add this billing URL to sources and cite it in Cost and licensing. Do not equate an unpublished import-specific meter with an absence of ordinary Azure storage consumption.
